posts.author: jainpatti
posts.text: I think there is a subsidiary drag on the results while parent company’s standalone operations performed strongly, the company’s consolidated net profit (₹25.65 crore) fell short of its standalone net profit (₹28.96 crore). This is due to net losses of ₹5.84 crore of its German subsidiary. There is also increase in operational expenses due to rise in depreciation and amortization expenses, which jumped to ₹9.27 crore from ₹5.92 crore quarter on quarter. Experienced members can throw light on this.
